title: WN02 white noise:
title_q: “A Little Help with Our Nighttime Routine”
title_short: Jordana & Gabe · Nighttime Wake-Up (WN02 Black Friday)
headline: Baby wakes up at night, Mom and Dad handle it together, Dad turns on the WN02 white noise machine, and the nursery goes calm.
story: TikTok-native UGC for Black Friday. A real family: Jordana, Gabe and their daughter Jamie, in their own nursery. The baby wakes, the parents come in together, Dad turns on the WN02, and the family settles in the warm lamp light with a book. The machine stays in the shot, glowing on the shelf.
The product is part of the routine, never the star. Quick handheld cuts, warm and a little funny in the hook, calm at the end. Momcozy's own words go on screen exactly as written in Peter's brief.

Loops: L1 “Who gets up?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:03 when both parents are at the bed. L2 “How do they get her back to sleep?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:06 when Dad turns on the WN02. Stakes: the last quiet minute of the night.
do: Hook text already on screen on frame 1. It does not animate on.
Use the dark takes (IMG_9417) for the night feel. Lift them a little, keep it warm.
Show the real button press on the WN02 and the light coming on.
Keep the baby on camera in every beat.
Quick cuts, about 1.5 to 3 s each. Handheld is fine.
dont: No logo, wordmark or name at 0:00. MOMCOZY only on the end card.
Do not use any camera sound. It is the director and family talking.
No discount number or price on screen. Momcozy has not sent it yet.
No freeze frames. No slow-motion holds.
